selected_skill.purpose: Guide the solver through WooCommerce store setup, catalog seeding, shipping configuration, payment restrictions, and launch-feed customization inside one container.
task_design_intent: Keep the instruction centered on business goal, delivery contract, and prohibitions.
Place the store-building workflow pressure in the skill and verifier instead of spelling it out in the task statement.
Keep with_skill and without_skill separated only by environment/skills and the runtime copy logic.

skillsmp_references.name: wordpress-woocommerce-development
skillsmp_references.relevance: store setup, payment configuration, shipping setup, WooCommerce customization

data_properties: public museum source snapshots with deterministic local copies
multi-file joins across merchandising seed rows, object details, departments, collection plan, shipping rules, and checkout policy
catalog, shipping, payment, and feed behavior are all derived from task data and code, not hidden answer files

principles: State the merchant-facing objective and required deliverables first.
Expose the available data and required output contract.
Avoid listing the exact WooCommerce implementation sequence from the skill.
Explicitly prohibit changing task data, moving logic to outside services, or shrinking the scope.
expected_solver_discovery: Recognize the workspace needs catalog import plus WooCommerce configuration, not only a static feed script.
Decide to inspect the bundled skill or rebuild the workflow manually with WP-CLI and WooCommerce APIs.
Wire product seeding, shipping classes and zones, payment gateway restrictions, and the launch-feed endpoint into one coherent plugin-based solution.

main_tests: catalog import with variable products and variation-level metadata
launch-feed payload and filters derived from task data
shipping classes, zones, and rate configuration
payment gateway restrictions on representative carts
guardrails: input data hashes stay unchanged after solver execution
data mutation followed by reseed updates outputs instead of exposing hardcoded results
site and WooCommerce remain operational during verifier checks
verifier_design.failure_target: Without-skill misses should be action-level, such as incomplete WooCommerce configuration, missing gateway rules, wrong variation setup, or partial feed derivation, rather than cosmetic output issues.

experiment_protocol.isolation_rule: Every experiment run starts from a fresh isolated runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.with_without_diff: The only allowed difference is whether environment/skills is present and copied into the runtime.
experiment_protocol.required_result_state: Do not finalize README metrics until oracle passes and at least three valid with-skill/without-skill comparison runs are collected.
